summary: Refined the client-surface interpretation (child question cb86a487ef704d8dbb90189aa23abcfc-question-1) with the checked call order and its two admission guards: both public read entry points take a caller-supplied timeout that linearizableRead converts to the node's timeout tick, and node.read rejects an uninitialized node with ErrClusterNotReady and a witness with ErrInvalidOperation before registering the read. So the pending batch the parent defect strands is reachable only by an initialized non-witness member, and its wait is bounded by the caller's deadline. Added a knowledge use of the new read-chain entry and one limitation recording that witness clients never reach the batch while observer reads use the parent's measured forwarding path. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with an interpretation append changing rationale, knowledge and limitations. No execution was run.
